name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 78 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 78b. Underlines that Europe must remain a continent of affordable mobility and free consumer choice, not a market reserved for the wealthy; stresses that the automotive sector is a strategic pillar of EU industry and employment, and that blanket bans accelerate factory closures, job losses and the relocation of production to outside the EU; warns that unilateral restrictions, combined with rising energy and regulatory costs, undermine competitiveness and expose the market to subsidised imports and unfair trade practices; calls for a technology-open framework that allows manufacturers to compete and innovate, including through efficient engines and cleaner fuels, while improving infrastructure in line with real demand and grid capacity; calls on the Commission to present, without delay, a revised proposal that replaces prohibitions with practical, pro-industry solutions and restores a level playing field for EU producers and workers;
